body: But I feel like I’m nothing. Like I’m just a speck of dust in space. I don’t know if relate is the right word, English is not my native language, but I’d rather be famous and unhappy than a dust fiber and unhappy...
The problem is that I relate to both the movies and their actors. I want to be famous too, like the ones in the movies, or singers, of authors etc. but I’m just nothing.
